title: Worker checks
summary: This page provides information on various types of worker checks required for employment in New South Wales.

internal_links.text: National Disability Insurance Scheme Worker Check (NDISWC)

faqs.q: What types of worker checks are available?
faqs.a: The page provides information on the Working with Children Check, the National Disability Insurance Scheme Worker Check (NDISWC), and the National Police Check.

faqs.q: Where can I apply for a Working with Children Check?
faqs.a: You can find more information about the Working with Children Check at the dedicated service page.

faqs.q: How do I apply for an NDIS Worker Check?
faqs.a: Information regarding the National Disability Insurance Scheme Worker Check (NDISWC) is available on the dedicated service page.
